definition: εἰλικρινής, -ές,  [in LXX: Wi 72^ kB * ;] unalloyed, pure (Lat. sincerus; see DCG, ii, 635a); __(a) of unmixed substances;  __(b) of abstract ideas;  __(with) of ethical purity: Php.1:10, 2Pe.3:1.† SYN.: ἁγνός (which see), καθαρός, cf. Tr., Syn.: §lxxxv; DB, iv, 176a; Cremer, 378; Westc. on 1Jn.3:3. (AS)
